# Tires, wheels and fitment

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

Weld-on Beadlock Kit inner rings flush with wheel lip then tack welded in four places. [t1001]

[Partial] Verify the tire size matches a 15-inch rim and check if the brake caliper fits. [t608]

[Partial] Select a 265/75R16 Cooper Discoverer STT Maxx tire and mount the new tires on the vehicle wheels. [t433]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. [Partial] Identify the specific area on the fender requiring modification.
2. Heat the inside corner of the plastic bulge with a hair dryer first, then finish heating it further with a small lighter to make it pliable.
3. Wedge a small 2x4 between the heated fender and the tire to hold the plastic in place without pushing too hard into the material.
4. Move along the bottom edge of the bulge, repeating the hair dryer followed by the lighter heating sequence while slowly pushing inward with the 2x4.
5. Work higher up on the remaining portion of the bulge to push in as much of the largest plastic section as possible using the same heat and pressure method.
6. [Partial] Spray a small squirt bottle filled with ice water onto the area immediately after heating and applying pressure to help the plastic set quickly.

_Procedure reported by [t862]. Photos of this job are in the source: <https://www.xterranation.org/index.php?threads/how-to-the-melt-mod-33-tires-on-2nd-gen.2992/>_

<details><summary>Alternate procedure [t1001] [Partial]</summary>

1. Wear safety glasses, earplugs, and gloves as per the power tool manufacturer's procedures.
2. Clean all areas to be welded until they are free of paint, grease, and rust.
3. Position the inner rings so their bottom surface is flush with the top lip on the wheel.
4. [Partial] Tack weld the assembly in four places to check its position.
5. [Partial] Weld around the entire circumference to seal everything up airtight.

</details>

<details><summary>Alternate procedure [t433] [Partial]</summary>

1. [Partial] Select a 265/75R16 Cooper Discoverer STT Maxx tire.
2. [Partial] Mount the new tires on the vehicle wheels.

</details>

## Tips & gotchas

- [Partial] Use a 2x4 instead of a hammer for better control and less risk of melting holes. [t862]
- Spray the area with ice water immediately after heating to speed up cooling and setting. [t862]
- Use power tools and proper PPE including safety glasses, earplugs, and gloves. [t1001]
- [Partial] Ensure inner rings are positioned to provide an excellent gap between metals for a good penetrating weld. [t1001]

## Common mistakes

- [Partial] Pushing directly into the plastic corner, which can melt through if not careful. [t862]
